title: FP8/INT8 Benchmark Matrix (Top Hosted Models x GPU x Quant Mode)
content:
Last updated: 2025-10-12 (Rina)

Purpose
- Single source of truth for the sprint run matrix (model x GPU x quant mode), run status, and headline metrics.
- This is a working sheet; numbers can change as we re-run for noise, fix kernel selection, or adjust scheduler caps.

Assumptions / Conventions
- Workload presets come from benchmark-lab matrix generator (see benchmark-lab PR #414).
- Metric definitions follow ADR: adr-quant-benchmark-metrics-and-definitions.
- End-to-end metrics are for streaming chat unless noted.
- TTFT = time to first token; TPOT = time per output token (decode).
- Cost proxy is relative; computed as (GPU_seconds / 1M_output_tokens) * internal $/GPU-second by SKU (not customer pricing).
- Runtime build is pinned via perf-lab build target + container digest (redwood PR #10626 + benchmark-lab PR #412).

Legend
- Run status: PLANNED | RUNNING | DONE | NEEDS_RERUN | BLOCKED
- Anomaly flags: NOISE | REGRESSION | KSEL (kernel selection) | OOM | CORRECTNESS | INFRA
